spec.problem: The learner Feedback form posts to /api/feedback, but no local route or Go handler exists, so valid feedback returns 404 and cannot persist.

acceptance.text: Visible anonymous and authenticated feedback forms submit through the browser to a real POST endpoint; valid text is persisted, invalid payloads and rate-limit overflow are rejected, and success is rendered only for a persisted 201 response.
Feedback fields expose associated localized accessible names; failures preserve entered values, loading prevents duplicate submits, and the form fits a 390x844 viewport.

spec.expected_behavior: Public feedback submissions are validated, rate limited, persisted in PostgreSQL, and return a success response only after persistence. The localized UI preserves entered values after failure, shows success after a saved response, associates labels with fields, and remains usable at 390x844.
spec.observed_behavior: Visible /vi/feedback renders the form, but a real submit returned HTTP 404 and displayed the generic send failure. Labels are not programmatically associated with fields.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert the feedback table migration/model, Go handler/router/tests, and page changes together; no existing learner content rows are modified.
